comment: Hand-encoded per-lane dispositions for the ten faststart-v2 lanes, derived only from committed lane evidence at the pinned catalog commit. Evidence refs and measured timings are pulled from the vendored catalog row (provenance + startup.measured); this file records only the classification decision and its basis. The Boltz external-/tmp worktree was read as evidence only and never edited.

faststart:boltz2@sha256:0788c95c8b5b6c1a.basis: fresh fail-closed n=20 with 20/20 semantically valid restores on the exact pinned digest; the proven route restores in-Pod process state directly (a writeback variant was evaluated and rejected).
caveats: Conservative-upper p95 30.310246 s fails the <30 s SLO; this is a latency result, not a safety failure.

An external-/tmp state-externalization optimization is tracked by a sibling task (boltz2-under-20-optimization); if adopted, that variant must be re-qualified and would reclassify to snapshot-after-state-externalization.

faststart:diffdock@sha256:300696eb8331d7.basis: exact response-boundary n=3 restores with strict semantic validation on the pinned digest; restored process state in Pod with a prewarmed read-only artifact volume.

faststart:msa-search@sha256:944f3cf84576.basis: native capture v1 was excluded for a current-artifact topology mismatch, not an inherent runtime prohibition: the donor captured /opt/nim/workspace as emptyDir while the qualified target used the final cache PVC, and the MMseqs shared-memory token differed because a compatibility symlink changed the canonical database path; no native attempt passed strict inference semantics. The mismatch is correctable: the prescribed fix is a fresh checkpoint captured with the final cache PVC mounted identically at /opt/nim/.cache and /opt/nim/workspace, qualified with identical target mounts, and the checked-in donor/target templates now express that aligned topology. Until that recapture qualifies, the selected route is a measured conventional cached start (exact response-boundary conventional n=3, T0-to-call-2 median 4.942788 s) under the same T0/readiness/request boundaries.
caveats: Reclassification out of conventional-only requires the prescribed topology-aligned recapture and exact qualification evidence through the shared canary process.

faststart:evo2-40b@sha256:561886bab1d2d0.basis: only manual/provisional restore-trigger evidence exists (65.377 s median from an in-Pod trigger, not target-create T0); production-shaped capture is deferred pending an explicit owner decision to release the only allowed H200; writable state on the production-shaped route is unknown.
caveats: The lane profile pins a single-H200 configuration while the Terraform catalog requests 2 GPUs for the same image; this discrepancy must be resolved before any capture qualification.
